tasks.spec:
You are a Python engineer adding ONE small, story-agnostic presentation capability to the freytag-forge engine. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, never call a billed model or the network. FIRST run: ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv ; then `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider <tests>` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` / `-m ruff check` (confirm `python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)"` prints a path inside this worktree).

HARD BOUNDARIES. Do NOT edit anything under data/ (no story data: the Continuity Initiative package is NOT part of this task). Do NOT edit tests/test_reveal_prerequisites.py or the reveal-prerequisite guard in storygame/story_package/loader.py / storygame/story_package/obligations.py (the "stranded reveal" check: it must keep rejecting exactly what it rejects today; variants must NOT influence it). Do NOT touch packages/worldkeeper (this is package-aware projection, not world-model logic). Do NOT put story names (Continuity, Kristin, Brandon, 2C, ledger facts) in engine code. Only edit the files you need under: storygame/, tests/ (new test file tests/test_delivery_variants.py plus minimal additions to existing tests you must update), docs/markdown-story-authoring/knowledge-and-disclosure.md, scripts/generate_spine_expected_reveals.py (ONLY its scripted-provider line that reads item.delivery_text; see 6).

THE FEATURE: `delivery_variants` on a knowledge definition. Today a KnowledgeDefinition (storygame/story_package/models.py, class KnowledgeDefinition) has one optional `delivery_text: str | None`; storygame/runtime/knowledge.py `_candidate()` (called from `_candidates()`, which already has `state`) copies it unchanged into RevealCandidate.delivery_text, which the exact matcher (storygame/runtime/candidate_matcher.py) and the semantic matcher (storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py) both consume. New contract (implement exactly this):

  `delivery_variants` optionally supplies complete replacement delivery texts. Each variant has a non-empty `requires` list of fact IDs and non-blank `text`. All required facts must already be true when the reveal is projected. Exactly one matching variant replaces `delivery_text`. No match uses `delivery_text`. Multiple matches are ambiguous: the candidate is NOT offered at all on that turn (fail closed: it is omitted from the projected candidates, so no delivery text is exposed and nothing is committed); do not pick the first. Variants change wording only. They cannot change eligibility (requires), effects (establishes), source, knowledge ID, action matching (action_evidence), or scene completion. Only the selected text is exposed on the delivery turn.

Steps:
1. models.py: add a typed `DeliveryVariant` model (same _Model base/strictness as its neighbours: `requires: tuple[str, ...]` min length 1 with each a fact id matching the module's existing id pattern, `text: str` non-blank with a validator like the existing non-empty delivery_text validator) and a field `delivery_variants: tuple[DeliveryVariant, ...] = ()` on KnowledgeDefinition. It must be excluded from serialization when empty (follow how `voiceable`/`repeatable` use exclude_if) so a package WITHOUT variants serializes and fingerprints byte-for-byte as before. Prove it: existing packages' fingerprints must not change (run tests/test_markdown_story_package.py and any fingerprint/save tests).
2. Parsing: find how knowledge.yaml is read into KnowledgeDefinition (loader / markdown package code; grep "delivery_text") and make sure `delivery_variants` flows through any allow-list of keys. A knowledge entry with variants but a missing/blank base `delivery_text` must be rejected at load with a clear StoryPackageError. Also reject, at load: unknown fact ids in a variant's `requires` (use the loader's existing registered-fact check style), and duplicate identical requires sets.
3. loader.py `_validate_authored_handoffs`: apply the SAME hygiene to every variant text that it applies to the base delivery_text: must_convey groups (use `unconveyed_terms`), implementation-only tokens (`_delivery_internal_token` reads item.delivery_text; generalise it to take the text) and the existing narration-term/protected-term checks that apply to delivery_text (grep the loader for other checks on delivery_text and mirror all). Error messages must name the knowledge id and say which variant (index) failed. Variants must not be an unchecked prose path.
4. A single story-agnostic selector, e.g. a function `resolve_delivery_text(item, true_fact_ids) -> str | None | AMBIGUOUS` placed next to the projection code (storygame/runtime/knowledge.py or a small new module storygame/runtime/delivery_text.py), pure and state-free apart from the set of true fact ids. Use it in knowledge.py `_candidates()`/`_candidate()` (thread `state` in; determine true facts the same way the rest of knowledge.py/reveal_eligibility.py tests predicates, via `state.facts`) so RevealCandidate.delivery_text is the SELECTED text; ambiguous => omit that candidate. Exact and semantic handoffs then consume the same resolved text automatically; verify by reading candidate_matcher.py and cloudflare.py that nothing re-reads KnowledgeDefinition.delivery_text from the definition after projection (they use the candidate). RevealCandidate must NOT expose the variants (keep delivery_text exclude=True as now).
5. AUDIT every other raw reader of `KnowledgeDefinition.delivery_text` (grep -rn "delivery_text" storygame/): storygame/personas.py (~line 47: scripted provider `knowledge.delivery_text or knowledge.statement`, and ~line 80 `_legacy_package`), storygame/runtime/recent_cue.py (~line 150, referent evidence uses entry.delivery_text), storygame/runtime/engine.py (refusal composition; check whether any reads the definition's text), capture.py. For each: if it must show what the player actually saw, route it through the selector with the current state's true facts; if it is only about the neutral base (e.g. evidence matching), leave it and say why in a one-line code comment ONLY if non-obvious. Report each reader and your decision in your final message.
6. scripts/generate_spine_expected_reveals.py has a scripted provider with `text = item.delivery_text or item.statement` (grep to find). Change it to use the selector with the simulated state's facts (or the handoff's selected delivery_text if available there) so offline simulations render the resolved text. Keep its behaviour identical for entries without variants.
7. Docs: in docs/markdown-story-authoring/knowledge-and-disclosure.md, next to the existing `delivery_text` explanation, add a short subsection on `delivery_variants` stating the contract above in plain words (12th-grade level, short sentences) plus a 6-line YAML example using generic ids (no Continuity names). Keep the file's existing text otherwise unchanged. Do not exceed ~150 added words.
8. Tests (new file tests/test_delivery_variants.py, hermetic, no live worker, no model calls; use the lighthouse fixture at tests/fixtures/stories/lighthouse-incident via the copy-to-tmp_path pattern in tests/test_entry_variants.py, NOT the Continuity package): (a) no variants => RevealCandidate.delivery_text == base and model dump / fingerprint unchanged; (b) one matching variant replaces base; (c) no match uses base; (d) two matching variants => candidate omitted from projection; (e) load rejections: unknown fact id, blank text, empty requires, variants without base delivery_text, variant text missing a must_convey term, variant containing an implementation token/protected term; (f) variants do not change eligibility, `establishes`, or action matching: a variant's `requires` unmet/met never makes an otherwise-ineligible reveal eligible and never blocks an eligible one; (g) the exact matcher AND the semantic path (stub the semantic call the way tests/test_candidate_matcher.py or tests/test_cloudflare_transport.py already do) both return the selected variant text; (h) save/restore recomputes the same text purely from facts (no new mutable state: assert the runtime state/snapshot has no new field); (i) no prompt/context handed to the narrator before delivery contains any variant text. Keep each test small. Player commands in tests are imperative first-person text per docs/player-input-guide.md ("Tell the keeper my answer."), never questions.

Run, and fix until green: tests/test_delivery_variants.py tests/test_reveal_prerequisites.py tests/test_entry_variants.py tests/test_markdown_story_package.py tests/test_knowledge_projection.py tests/test_candidate_matcher.py tests/test_cloudflare_transport.py tests/test_knowledge_leakage_matrix.py tests/test_spine_expected_reveals.py (whichever of those files exist) and `ruff format` + `ruff check` on everything you touched.

OUTPUT: leave changes uncommitted. Final message: files changed, the reader-audit table from step 5, the exact selector signature, and anything you could not do.
